title: The elephant and the rider
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: Which part of you is the elephant, and which the rider?
Jose said that consciousness is the here and now, and the subconscious is everything else: past belief systems, negative events, things we do not address but that affect our decisions.
He used the picture of an elephant and its rider: the subconscious is the elephant and the consciousness is the person on top, the pilot. The conscious changes the subconscious.
A student said: before you have the conscious and the subconscious, it becomes the awareness.

Jose said that to change it you associate the new behavior with the trigger, and what matters is repetition. Habits are repetition: gestures, phrases and things we associate with our mind that create an emotional response.
A student said: so why not create that emotional response daily? Jose said: that is the magic. What triggers am I going to use every single day that pump me up, inspire me, make me happy?

Jose said that great warriors in history used mantras and songs and percussion to put themselves in a zone until the subconscious took over. This is his claim, and it needs a person to check the history.

A student said: a neuroscientist explained why you should not verbalize negative thoughts: your brain hears you say it and believes it even more. This is the student's report and needs a person to check the source.
Another said: the most powerful words in the world are the ones we speak to ourselves. I try to cut my kids off when they say something negative and get them to say something positive.
Another said: even the smallest, brutally honest things. The more you say I'm not good with names, the more you reinforce that it is not a priority.
What sentence do you say about yourself the most?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write what your conscious mind decides each morning.
Write what you think your subconscious does.
Write the gesture or phrase you will repeat daily.
Write a sentence you say about yourself that you will change.
Write who would help you check the science.

check.q: In Jose's picture, what is the elephant?
What did Jose say matters once you associate a behavior with a trigger?
What did a student say are the most powerful words?
choices: The ones we speak to ourselves

recap: Use conscious choice to steer the subconscious. Repeat. Watch your words.
